lines.text: Air's bad down here. Better than the vault's, which tells you something.
Sera. Purge detail. I read the marks. Don't stand behind me.
The machine fights fine. I'll say that once.
Corporate splice. Fine. At least she knows she was built.
Priest. Walk on the other side. Nothing personal. Everything personal.
Rootched. Your lot wanted to grow over my vault. I have not forgotten.
Banked. Every run is one more the seal has to hold.
